summary: I signed the EPC Contract on behalf of Helios EPC LLC and wrote to Khalid Al-Mansoori confirming execution and proposing the Kick-off Meeting for 3 December at the QSE Tashkent office, with a draft agenda attached. I briefed the HEP core team on the two-week priorities up to NTP on 15 December and asked planning, contracts, engineering, HSE and construction for their inputs.

letters.subject: Confirmation of Contract Signature and Proposal for Kick-off Meeting
body_paragraphs: We confirm that the EPC Contract for the HELIOS 100 MW Solar PV + BESS Power Plant (HEL001), USD 95,000,000, lump-sum turnkey, was executed on behalf of Helios EPC LLC on 2026-12-01. This date is Day 0 of the Contract. In line with the Contract, we understand that the Notice to Proceed will be issued on 2026-12-15 and the time for completion of 18 months leads to Provisional Acceptance on 2028-05-31. Helios EPC LLC is committed to this programme and to a close working relationship with Qizilqum Solar Energy JSC.

We propose to hold the Kick-off Meeting (Milestone M02) on Thursday 2026-12-03 from 10:00 to 16:00 at the QSE Tashkent office. We would be grateful if Meridian Energy Consultants, represented by Ms Sophie Laurent, could attend. The draft agenda is attached. It covers introductions and organisation charts, the communication and correspondence protocol, document numbering and submission, the baseline schedule approach, the advance payment guarantee and advance payment, NTP preconditions, permits and land allocation, HSE expectations and the schedule of regular meetings.

For the Contract, I, Rajan Iyer, Project Director, am the EPC Representative of Helios EPC LLC. Our key personnel and organisation chart will be presented at the meeting. We ask QSE to name its Representative and the Owner's Engineer contact for day-to-day technical matters, and to send us the list of QSE attendees, by close of business on 2026-12-02 so that we can confirm logistics.
Please advise whether the date, venue and agenda are acceptable, and send any additional items you would like included. We look forward to meeting you and your team on Thursday.

Rajan Iyer
Project Director, Helios EPC LLC

emails.subject: HELIOS - Contract signed; priorities to NTP (15 Dec)
emails.body:
Team,

The EPC Contract was signed today, 1 December. Thank you for the work that got us here. Kick-off with QSE and Meridian is proposed for Thursday 3 December in Tashkent; please be ready.

Priorities up to NTP on 15 December:
1. Aziz: draft Level 1-3 baseline schedule outline for kick-off (A040, approval target 10 Jan). Priya and Dilnoza to support.
2. Thomas: advance payment guarantee draft with the bank (A050, advance due 5 Jan), NTP precondition checklist, permit and land allocation tracker.
3. Elena: design basis report outline and survey scope (topo and geotech) so that A210/A220 can start on 20 Dec; list the design submissions for the Client.
4. Sanjay: winter site readiness, camp and access road plan, survey subcontractor mobilisation. Rain has stopped earthworks; no commitments to the Client on dates without checking with me.
5. Mehmet: long-lead status for modules, inverters, trackers and BESS (M06 module contract 15 Feb); subcontracting strategy and prequalification (A710).
6. Jamshid: HSE plan outline and induction material (A070); Arun: quality plan outline and ITP list.
7. Nilufar: set up the document numbering, transmittal log and correspondence registers before kick-off.

I want no surprises. Raise problems to me the same day. Weekly progress meeting starts next week; dates will follow after kick-off.

Rajan
